## How to Acknowledge an Email

Here are some simple and professional ways to acknowledge an email:

---

### **Basic Acknowledgment Templates**

**Short & Simple:**
> "Thank you for your email. I have received it and will get back to you shortly."

**Confirming Receipt:**
> "This is to confirm that I have received your email. I will review it and respond as soon as possible."

**With a Timeline:**
> "Thank you for reaching out. I've received your message and will respond by [date/time]."

---

### **Key Elements to Include**

- ✅ **Greeting** – Address the sender by name
- ✅ **Confirm receipt** – Let them know you got it
- ✅ **Brief response** – Mention next steps if needed
- ✅ **Timeline** – When they can expect a full reply
- ✅ **Closing** – Professional sign-off

---

### **Quick Example**

> Hi [Name],
>
> Thank you for your email. I have received it and will review the details. I'll get back to you by **[date]**.
>
> Best regards,
> [Your Name]

---

### **Tips**
- Keep it **brief and clear**
- Reply **promptly** (within 24 hours)
- Be **polite and professional**
